races.name: Richard James Hone Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
AL SHABAB STORM is back to his smart self and looks ready to strike returned to calmer waters. The likeable Ancient State is a solid alternative, with King of Light best of the others.

  1. AL SHABAB STORM
  2. ANCIENT STATE (IRE)
  3. KING OF LIGHT

races.name: William Hill Futurity Trophy Stakes (Group 1) (Str)
races.verdict:
NOBLE EXHIBIT can become the third Aidan O'Brien-trained colt since 2021 to follow up victory in the Beresford at the Curragh with a win in the final Group 1 of the season in Britain. Stablemate Sergei Diaghilev can follow him home ahead of Karl Burke's Royal Lodge runner-up Burning Up.

  1. NOBLE EXHIBIT (IRE)
  2. SERGEI DIAGHILEV (IRE)
  3. BURNING UP

races.name: William Hill Remembering Sue Wright Prospect Stakes (Registered As Doncaster Stakes) (Listed)
races.verdict:
BENGAL TIGER had plenty spare in a soft-ground maiden at Naas recently and can prove too strong for fellow Irish raider Hi Corbett Court. Crystal Queen resumed her progression when second in a competitive nursery at Ayr last month and is next on the list.

  1. BENGAL TIGER (IRE)
  2. HI CORBETT COURT (IRE)
  3. CRYSTAL QUEEN (IRE)

races.name: Spooky Spectacular Fireworks At Doncaster Racecourse Nursery
races.verdict:
NATIONAL HONOUR's Kempton win last month has been strongly boosted by the second/third and he looks leniently treated assuming he can cope with this much deeper ground. Rock Steady Beat might be the one for the forecast spot.

  1. NATIONAL HONOUR (IRE)
  2. ROCK STEADY BEAT (IRE)
  3. SCIENZA

races.name: William Hill Epic Boosts Handicap (Str)
races.verdict:
The progressive ANYASI is proven in the mud and can get the better of fellow 3-y-o Shipbourne, who impressed on Southwell's AW last month and a heavy-ground debut success last autumn suggests today's ground shouldn't be an issue for him however much rain arrives. Lir Speciale also merits respect at a course he scored twice on deep ground at this time last year.

  1. ANYASI
  2. SHIPBOURNE
  3. LIR SPECIALE (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
HAVE SECRET has dipped to only 1 lb higher than when second in this on heavy last year and might be worth chancing having shaped as if still in good form when seventh in a big field at York a fortnight ago. The way Mondo Man ploughed through the mud to easily win the Imperial Cup over hurdles at Sandown back in March makes him an interesting contender, particularly as he was capable of smart form on the Flat in France earlier in his career. Shafdar and Castlemont also make the shortlist.

  1. HAVE SECRET (IRE)
  2. MONDO MAN
  3. SHAFDAR (IRE)

races.name: RFJ And Bee Jays Electrical Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
SALAM DUBAWI could be worth chancing off a tempting mark back down in class. It Just Takes Time bounced back to winning ways in this headgear at Catterick last week and is second choice, while fellow veteran Quest For Fun should be in the mix again.

  1. SALAM DUBAWI
  2. IT JUST TAKES TIME (IRE)
  3. QUEST FOR FUN

races.name: RFJ And Bee Jays Electrical Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
This looks stronger than the first division with plenty arriving on the back of encouraging runs, including PROSPERITAS, who won a division of this race comprehensively 12 months ago off 4 lb lower. Freddie Steady Go and Gold Queen Kindly are also building up to something so they head the dangers.

  1. PROSPERITAS (IRE)
  2. FREDDIE STEADY GO
  3. GOLD QUEEN KINDLY (IRE)

races.name: Stay For The After Party 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
EAZY BREEZY is a £120,000 purchase and looks bred for the job so he's of plenty of interest first time up. His stablemate Jessmarvel isn't without a chance, either, so the betting could be informative, while Royal March is another to note.

  1. EAZY BREEZY (IRE)
  2. JESSMARVEL (FR)
  3. ROYAL MARCH

races.name: Clifford, Martin & Sarah Firth Memorial Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Related to the top-class Paisley Park, SOCIETY SOLDIER looks sure to stay well and should relish this switch to fences. She is taken to prove too good for Realisation, who returns with her stable in excellent form, and the unexposed stayer Suspected.

  1. SOCIETY SOLDIER (IRE)
  2. REALISATION (FR)
  3. SUSPECTED (IRE)

races.name: Myles McNulty You're Never Sixty Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
BALLYFORT won this race a year ago and in the hope he can keep the errors down on reappearance, a repeat success may well be forthcoming. Achille des Rocs is a solid alternative, with Garde des Champs dangerous if reacting well to new headgear.

  1. BALLYFORT (IRE)
  2. ACHILLE DES ROCS (FR)
  3. GARDE DES CHAMPS (IRE)

races.name: luckytiger.co.uk Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TWO AULD PALS ran another solid race when third at Hexham 22 days ago and remains of interest for a yard operating at a healthy strike rate so far in October. Ashdown Forest may have more to offer for the Skeltons and heads up the opposition, along with Heart Above, who is most reliable at this track.

  1. TWO AULD PALS (IRE)
  2. ASHDOWN FOREST (IRE)
  3. HEART ABOVE

races.name: Edinburgh Gin Chase (Limited Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MYRETOWN ended last season on a whimper but should benefit from the marked step back up in trip and is taken to make the most of the significant drop in grade now reunited with Patrick Wadge for the first time since his 2025 Ultima success at the Cheltenham Festival. New Order returns to action with his yard firmly amongst the winners, so it’s reasonable to believe he can bounce back.

  1. MYRETOWN (IRE)
  2. NEW ORDER (IRE)
  3. MUMFORD'S MAGIC (IRE)

races.name: luckytiger.co.uk Best Odds Guaranteed Nuts Well Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NEWTOWN RAMBLER sets a useful standard in his bid to make it 4 on the bounce over fences. He gets the vote, though it's hardly a bullish one given the significant amount of rain forecast. Interesting chasing debutant Smoke Trail and Coup de Coeur are feared most, the latter with least to prove should conditions become testing.

  1. NEWTOWN RAMBLER (IRE)
  2. COUP DE COEUR (FR)
  3. SMOKE TRAIL (IRE)

races.name: racingtv/freetrial Conditional Jockeys' Training Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
LETS MINGLE finished second in this corresponding race last year and won't bump into such a progressive one this time around. She could be worth chancing over stablemate Bold Light, who has at least won on soft ground, while Maillot Blanc is a danger on the pick of his course form.

  1. LETS MINGLE (IRE)
  2. BOLD LIGHT (IRE)
  3. MAILLOT BLANC

races.name: William Hill Epic Boosts Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Henry de Bromhead took this 12 months ago and looks to have another likely sort in ROCKONLIAM who really impressed when scoring at Wexford last time and can extend his winning sequence to four here. Spectacularsunrise went in at the first time of asking over fences at Perth last month and could emerge as the main danger with better to come, although Palamon arrives at the top of his game and isn't dismissed lightly. Chasing newcomers Lisbane Park and De Temps En Temps need considering too.

  1. ROCKONLIAM (IRE)
  2. SPECTACULARSUNRISE
  3. PALAMON (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Extra Places Every Day Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
An excellent opportunity for ROAD TO WEMBLEY to quickly resume winning ways with trip/ground likely to suit. Kashchei is next best.

  1. ROAD TO WEMBLEY
  2. KASHCHEI
  3. NEWBROOK DIAMOND (IRE)

races.name: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Unexposed stayer SEANIECON caught the eye when an unlucky fifth in a listed handicap at Punchestown back in April and looks the type who'll relish the staying test this promises to be. Moon Rocket could be the main threat if recapturing the pick of his novice hurdle form. Ace Of Spades and Idaho Fire also appeal for top yards, with out-and-out stayer Love Of Neymore completing the shortlist.

  1. SEANIECON (IRE)
  2. MOON ROCKET (IRE)
  3. ACE OF SPADES (FR)

races.name: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KATATE DORI represents a yard that often has their horses cherry-ripe for their early season targets and is 3 lb lower than when going close at C&D on New Year's Day, so gets the verdict. Diamond Dealer had a very good time of things last season for Dan Skelton and has to be respected on his comeback, whilst Here Comes Georgie rates as an interesting recruit for that powerful yard.

  1. KATATE DORI (FR)
  2. DIAMOND DEALER (IRE)
  3. HERE COMES GEORGIE

races.name: Masterson Holdings Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
INDIAN RIVER can build on his recent comeback run and get back to the sort of form that saw him placed in an Aintree Grade 1 at the end of last season. North Shore is respected dropping back in trip, whilst last season's Adonis winner La Luna Artista remains with potential.

  1. INDIAN RIVER (IRE)
  2. NORTH SHORE (FR)
  3. LA LUNA ARTISTA (FR)

races.name: William Hill Price Boosts 'Chasing Excellence' Novices' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Anthony Honeyball took this race last year and he can repeat the feat with CATCHINTSAVO, who excelled himself when finishing runner-up in Grade 1 company at the Aintree festival and is every inch a chaser. Butch Cassidy has found his feet in this discipline and arriving on a hat-trick, he can provide most resistance. Derryhassen Paddy looked far from a natural on his chasing bow 11 months ago, but he's entitled to do better.

  1. CATCHINTSAVO (IRE)
  2. BUTCH CASSIDY (IRE)
  3. DERRYHASSEN PADDY (IRE)

races.name: Lucy's 40th Birthday Celebration Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Hard to rule out many in this bumper but with the Dan Skelton yard firing on all cylinders, NEWGROVE is put forward as the answer. He was an easy winner on his sole outing in Irish points earlier in the year and appears the stable first string on jockey bookings. Ballycrystal Boy was bought for a handsome sum after winning his sole start in Irish points and merits respect having joined the excellent Jamie Snowden stable. Delusionofgrandeur is the tentative pick of those with experience.

  1. NEWGROVE (IRE)
  2. BALLYCRYSTAL BOY (IRE)
  3. DELUSIONOFGRANDEUR (IRE)

races.name: Grundon Amateur Jockeys' Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
1. EDWARD SEXTON (IRE)
  2. BOY GEORGE
  3. ARTAVIAN

races.name: D&H Racing Stakes (Fillies' Listed) (Registered As The Radley Stakes)
races.verdict:
1. SIZZLING AFFAIR (IRE)
  2. DIPLOMATA
  3. SPIRITED GESTURE

races.name: BetVictor EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Str)
AWC Season 14 Has Begun Nursery
races.verdict:
BLAKE'S MONARCH was collared late by Bill The Bull at Newcastle last time but is fancied to turn the tables here on these 2 lb better term. Adam Kirby's colt still rates a big threat though, while Space Dreamer can't be ruled out on her first go on tapeta.

  1. BLAKE'S MONARCH (IRE)
  2. BILL THE BULL (IRE)
  3. SPACE DREAMER (IRE)

races.name: Midnite Are Upping The Betting Game Handicap
races.verdict:
This is wide open so it could be worth siding with GLAMOROUS BREEZE who scored on all-weather at Lingfield in 2025 and can capitalise on a handy-looking mark now back on an artificial surface for the first time this season. Almaty Star is feared most on the back of a good Leicester second, although both Bona Fortuna and Moulin Booj can also play a prominent role.

  1. GLAMOROUS BREEZE
  2. ALMATY STAR (IRE)
  3. BONA FORTUNA (IRE)

races.name: Join The Midnite Movement Handicap
races.verdict:
SPIRIT OF NATURE didn't get the best of runs when posting a personal best at Newcastle last month and makes plenty of appeal here. Wyvill and Masego are also of interest.

  1. SPIRIT OF NATURE (IRE)
  2. WYVILL
  3. MASEGO (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
RING OF MUSIC boasts an attractive pedigree and made an encouraging start to his career at Newcastle earlier this month. He can get off the mark. Potential improver Naval Empire may provide the chief threat, whilst National Anthem could be the pick of some interesting newcomers.

  1. RING OF MUSIC (IRE)
  2. NAVAL EMPIRE (IRE)
  3. NATIONAL ANTHEM

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
This can go to GEOMETRY, who only narrowly failed to open his account here earlier this month and remains with potential. The main threat may be provided by one of the newcomers, with Kings Medal and Champagne Poetry particularly of interest.

  1. GEOMETRY
  2. KINGS MEDAL
  3. CHAMPAGNE POETRY (IRE)

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
races.verdict:
KEV had nothing to spare at Wolverhampton on his most recent outing, but he's still lightly raced for his current yard and a 3 lb rise doesn't look insurmountable. Veteran Al Suil Eile caught the eye with how he made up his ground from a less-than-ideal position over C&D last month and will be a danger to all if building on that run, while Crown The Future is another last-time-out scorer who merits respect.

  1. KEV
  2. AL SUIL EILE (FR)
  3. CROWN THE FUTURE (IRE)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
races.verdict:
CAPTAIN PARMA went backwards from an encouraging recent run when last of 9 at Wolverhampton just over 3 weeks ago, but his overall record on all-weather suggests he's well worth another chance, especially now dropping back into 0-70 company. Shaw Park and Gladiadora are a couple from the bottom of the weights to consider.

  1. CAPTAIN PARMA (IRE)
  2. SHAW PARK (IRE)
  3. GLADIADORA (IRE)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Gelded on the back of his latest run, FLICK OF AN EYE looks well worth another chance to confirm his debut promise. Crystal Dark has shaped well to finish second on both starts to date and is likely to be knocking on the door again.

  1. FLICK OF AN EYE (IRE)
  2. CRYSTAL DARK
  3. AL ARRAAB (IRE)

races.name: Create Your Bet Builders At Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
AGE OF TIME shaped well last time and may make his second start for Tony Carroll a winning one. Mount Ruapehu is feared in his bid to make it 4-4 over C&D and heads the dangers along with interesting stable-switcher Mehmar. Due Date and Papa Don't Preach also merit consideration in a race where several look potentially well treated.

  1. AGE OF TIME (FR)
  2. MOUNT RUAPEHU (IRE)
  3. MEHMAR (IRE)

races.name: SANSERV Rated Novice Chase
races.verdict:
1. CORAL RIVER (IRE)
  2. KARL DES TOURELLES (FR)
  3. KING'S BUCKS (FR)

races.name: QuinnBet 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
1. SHARKEYBOY (FR)
  2. GREEN SOUL (IRE)
  3. BLISSFUL BONITA (IRE)

races.name: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
1. COOLISHAEL (IRE)
  2. IF YOU BELIEVE (IRE)
  3. GIVE IT A CRACK

races.name: Corrib Oil Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: BOYCETOWN acquitted himself well really well in the Champion Bumpers at both Cheltenham and Punchestown last season and makes obvious appeal on his hurdles bow. Thinkitdontjinxit and This Songisforyou may provide the chief threat.

races.name: W.B. Gavin & Co. Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
1. TEED UP (IRE)
  2. SHOOT FIRST (IRE)
  3. MYSTIC MALINA (IRE)

races.name: COLM QUINN BMW Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
1. VISION DE MAINE (FR)
  2. LALIGURASH (IRE)
  3. BALLAGH STAR (IRE)

races.name: Electric Galway (C & G) (Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict: MARBLE HILL has joined Gavin Cromwell since his promising Bellewstown debut earlier this year and remains with potential. He gets the nod in the finale. Bravemans Call and Ballyadam Star rate the principal dangers.
